column3: (Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments: words like "debug" in the minified third-party console bundle; no secrets)
(Non-Storable Content: API responses are Cache-Control no-store on purpose)
(Modern Web Application: informational, the console is a single-page app)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy missing: Low; the pages embed no cross-origin resources, COOP same-origin is set)
